Name: Hydro Thunder GO
Description: The classic arcade speedboat racer, gone mobile: blast through Time Attack courses, hit turbo starts and huge airborne jumps, smash up Venice, and rack up trophies and credits across every stage.

Achievements.Name: It's a Start
Achievements.Description: Earn a Bronze trophy or better on all stages.

Achievements.Name: Tick Tick Tick
Achievements.Description: Beat all par times in Time Attack.

Achievements.Name: Golden Delicious
Achievements.Description: Earn a Gold trophy on all stages with an Expert boat.

Achievements.Name: Taste My Wake
Achievements.Description: Download and beat a ghost in Time Attack.

Achievements.Name: Turbo Starter
Achievements.Description: Turbo Start in a race by tapping the screen in sync with the countdown.

Achievements.Name: Reckless Yachting
Achievements.Description: Destroy all Gondolas in Venice in a single race.

Achievements.Name: Overdrive
Achievements.Description: Have Boost activated throughout a whole race.
